kjv: Neither go into the town, nor tell it to any in the town
mine: Do not even enter the village
note: TR adds "mede eipes tini en te kome"; absent from Sinaiticus and Vaticanus.
psyche here (as in 8:35 "save his life ... lose it") is one's life or self; KJV switches between "life" in 8:35 and "soul" in 8:36-37 for the same word, obscuring the wordplay.
